items.title: OVHcloud Raises Prices as AI Memory Demand Reprices Non-AI Infrastructure
items.summaryShort: OVHcloud Raises Prices as AI Memory Demand Reprices Non-AI Infrastructure. OVHcloud will raise prices from September, with 2026-edition gaming servers up 87 percent and other recent servers 40 to 59 percent.

items.title: DRAM Controller Register Manipulation Breaks CPU Memory Isolation
items.summaryShort: DRAM Controller Register Manipulation Breaks CPU Memory Isolation. Security researcher Christopher Domas developed skitter-creek-bath-salts, an open-source hardware security tool that disrupts CPU privilege boundaries by manipulating memory

items.title: Cloudflare Announces Kitesurf, a Browser Engine for Agents
items.summaryShort: Cloudflare Announces Kitesurf, a Browser Engine for Agents. Cloudflare recently introduced Kitesurf, a lightweight browser built for automated workloads.

items.title: Presentation: SafeChat: Building AI-Powered Safety Systems at Scale in a Real-Time Marketplace
items.summaryShort: Presentation: SafeChat: Building AI-Powered Safety Systems at Scale in a Real-Time Marketplace. Bruna Pereira explains how DoorDash built a content-agnostic AI moderation platform.

items.title: AI Code Review at Scale: LinkedIn's Multi-Agent Approach
items.summaryShort: AI Code Review at Scale: LinkedIn's Multi-Agent Approach. At LinkedIn's scale, relying solely on human reviewers or simply putting an off-the-shelf AI reviewer in front of GitHub is not an effective way to manage PRs.

items.title: Two years after launch, Walmart's Flipkart is closing in on India's quick-commerce leaders
items.summaryShort: Two years after launch, Walmart's Flipkart is closing in on India's quick-commerce leaders. Flipkart's quick-commerce venture is delivering 1.1 million to 1.2 million orders a day, nearly triple its November volume.

items.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
items.summaryShort: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors. In the HBS Foundry program, AI avatars provide feedback during practice pitches and board meetings.

items.title: Will the DOJ's investigation into a16z spook other VCs?
items.summaryShort: Will the DOJ's investigation into a16z spook other VCs?. On the latest episode of Equity, we wonder why the DOJ is investigating startup board seats.
